entries.mechanism: TAXSIM runs at its latest 2024 law year. Alabama's section 40-18-5 rate schedule (2/4/5 per cent) is unchanged between 2024 and 2026; the residual is the section 40-18-15(a)(1) federal-income-tax-deduction vintage. Alabama deducts the filer's federal income tax, which fell from 2024 to 2026 as the OBBBA rate schedule took effect, so the 2026 Alabama taxable income and tax are higher than TAXSIM's 2024 computation. The pipeline reports 1174.00; TAXSIM 2024 reports 1164.73. Pinned-2024-law-year vintage, not a pipeline defect; the pipeline matches PolicyEngine at 2026 to the cent.
